ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Neutralization — Frostline Sector — SATELLITE EDITION
ObjectStates.Description:
Neutralization / Frostline Sector
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Source: SET_Colder Than Carbonite - 2026 - Table 06 - Canada - V1.5
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3486064611
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/27ef9160-bb5e-40b0-92e8-a7271ad38558
Mission positions retained; scenery adjusted for objective clearance.
Live TTS physics and playtesting pending.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Tile
ContainedObjects.Description:
A gaming mat by Micro Art Studio licensed by Corvus Belli

(c) Micro Art Studio 2020, (c) Corvus Belli 2020
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Mission markings retained from the map bag loader.
local LOBO_MISSION_LINES=JSON.decode("[{\"points\":[[12,4.6400581741333,-24],[12,4.6400581741333,24]],\"color\":[0.9,0.55,0.1],\"thickness\":0.045},{\"points\":[[-12,4.6400581741333,-24],[-12,4.6400581741333,24]],\"color\":[0.9,0.55,0.1],\"thickness\":0.045}]")
local loboSurfaceOnLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboSurfaceOnLoad then loboSurfaceOnLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(function()
  local localLines={}
  local scale=self.getScale()
  local lineScale=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),0.000001)
  for _,line in ipairs(LOBO_MISSION_LINES) do
   local points={}
   for _,point in ipairs(line.points) do
    local p=self.positionToLocal(point)
    points[#points+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   end
   localLines[#localLines+1]={points=points,color=line.color,thickness=line.thickness/lineScale}
  end
  self.setVectorLines(localLines)
 end,2)
end

-- Preserve authored scenery while the map is deployed.

function onLoad(saved)
 self.setLock(true)
 if satelliteOriginalOnLoad then satelliteOriginalOnLoad(saved) end
end
